$comment: Test-only content variant of the P1 launch state (#23): it proves the hero renders a licensed documentary image when the content carries a cleared one. No licensed photograph exists at launch, so `p1` keeps the typographic fallback and this scenario supplies a rights-cleared media record through the content seam. The alt text is generic on purpose (no place is claimed until it is verified); the media URL is a scenario fixture and is not shipped on the launch page. Everything else — gates, domains, jobs, sitemap — is the `p1` launch state, including the Carrières utility page open in the footer (#27) and the legal utility pages published (#28).
